chooseTerminal: Where will you collect your medicines?
chooseTerminalDescription: Choose a H.A.V.E Terminal first. You will browse only the medicines available at that machine and collect your paid order there.
noTerminals: No collection Terminals are available right now.
unavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please refresh.
terminalUnavailable: This kiosk is unavailable at the moment
terminalInUse: This kiosk is physically used by another user.
terminalInUseDescription: You can still browse its medicines. Someone at this kiosk may buy a product while you are browsing, so availability can change before checkout.
terminalOwnSession: Your session is open at this kiosk
testMode: Kashier test mode · Academic demonstration. Do not enter real card details.
cartUnavailable: Your cart could not be checked. Refresh before continuing.
cartIssues: Some cart items cannot be purchased from this Terminal. Adjust or remove them before checkout.
hostedInfo: Continue to Kashier's hosted test checkout. Card details are entered there, never in H.A.V.E.
cartNotice: Items are not reserved until checkout starts. Prices are in EGP with no added tax.
checkoutConflict: Your cart or available stock changed. Review the current cart before trying again.
paymentUnavailable: Kashier test checkout is unavailable. No payment is confirmed. Check Order history before trying again.
checkoutUnconfirmed: Checkout was not confirmed. Check Order history first. A manual retry uses the same request key while this screen stays open.
unsafeCheckout: The payment destination could not be verified. We did not open it. Refresh this order or try again later.
orderNotFound: This order was not found for your account.
cancelCheckoutConfirm: Cancel this unfinished checkout? We will check its payment status before releasing reserved stock. Your saved basket is kept.
checkoutWindowEnded: The payment window has ended. This checkout cannot be resumed. The backend is checking its final payment status.
checkoutSnapshot: This checkout keeps its original items and amount. Editing your saved basket does not change it.
resumeInfo: Continue the same payment from Hub or the assigned kiosk before the deadline. Completing a kiosk purchase remotely requires collection at that machine.
resumeConflict: This checkout changed or its payment window ended. We loaded the latest status. Review it before continuing.
resumeUnconfirmed: Payment could not be resumed. Check this checkout's status before trying again; do not start another payment while the outcome is unclear.
cartAfterPayment: Your saved basket changed after checkout began, so we kept those changes. This order was paid using its original items and amount.
paymentConfirmed: Payment is confirmed. Check this order for the fulfilment result.
returnChecking: Checking this order with the backend. A payment-return URL does not confirm payment.
paymentPending: Payment is not confirmed yet. Refresh this order or check your order history. Do not make another payment while the outcome is unclear.
readyForCollection: Payment is confirmed. Sign in at the collection Terminal and open My profile → Order history to collect before the deadline.
reviewRequired: This order needs review. Do not retry payment or collection while its result is uncertain.
cancelledNote: This order has been cancelled. Any recorded refund is shown above.
cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? Reserved stock will be released. If payment was confirmed, the backend will request the appropriate test refund.
reorderConfirm: Add this order's items to your Hub cart at the original collection Terminal? Current prices and availability apply.
replaceCartConfirm: Your Hub cart is not empty. Replace it with this order's items? Current prices and availability apply.
actionConflict: This order or cart changed. Refresh and review it before making the choice again.
actionUnconfirmed: The change was not confirmed. Refresh and check the order/cart before trying again.
savedCardsInfo: Your first saved card is created during a Hub purchase in Kashier's hosted checkout. We do not offer a separate add-card form and never store card numbers or security codes. Later purchases can use provider-saved methods if Kashier offers them.
noCards: No saved payment methods yet. Start a Hub purchase to save a test method in Kashier.
collectionWindowEnded: The collection window has ended. The backend will confirm expiry/refund processing.
refundConfirmed: Kashier confirmed the full test refund.
refundFailed: The refund failed and needs owner review. It is not completed.
refundProcessing: The full test refund is being checked or processed; it is not confirmed yet.
checkingPaymentHelp: Payment verification is still pending; cancellation is not confirmed. Do not pay again. Refresh the order status. If it cannot be verified, contact support with the order reference. Your saved basket is kept.
